arxiv-2107-13467.title: Recursively Conditional Gaussian for Ordinal Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2107-13467.creator: Xiaofeng Liu, Site Li, Yubin Ge, Pengyi Ye, Jane You, Jun Lu
arxiv-2107-13467.description: Abstract The unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely adopted to alleviate the data scalability issue, while the existing works usually focus on classifying independently discrete labels. However, in many tasks (e.g., medical diagnosis), the labels are discrete and successively distributed. The UDA for ordinal classification requires inducing non-trivial ordinal distribution prior to the latent space.

arxiv-2109-07385.title: Collider search of light dark matter model with dark sector decay
arxiv-2109-07385.creator: Yu Cheng, Wei Liao, Qi-Shu Yan
arxiv-2109-07385.description: Abstract We explore the possibility that the dark matter relic density is not produced by thermal mechanism directly, but by the decay of other heavier dark sector particles which on the other hand can be produced by the thermal freeze-out mechanism.

arxiv-2111-14113.title: Appearance of peak in symmetry energy at N = 126 for Pb isotopic chain within relativistic energy density functional
arxiv-2111-14113.creator: Jeet Amrit Pattnaik 1, T. M. Joshua 2, Ankit Kumar 3,4, M. Bhuyan 5,6, S. K. Patra 3,4
arxiv-2111-14113.description: Abstract The newly derived relativistic energy density functional [ Phys. Rev. C 103 , 024305 (2021) ], which stems from the effective field theory motivated relativistic mean-field (E-RMF) is employed to establish the appearance of peak/kink in the symmetry energy over the isotopic chain of Pb- nuclei.

arxiv-2201-01577.title: Bulk-Bulk Correspondence in Disordered Non-Hermitian Systems
arxiv-2201-01577.creator: Zhi-Qiang Zhang, Hongfang Liu, Haiwen Liu, Hua Jiang, X. C. Xie
arxiv-2201-01577.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Qiang Zhang, Hongfang Liu, Haiwen Liu, Hua Jiang, X. C. Xie. The consistency between eigenvalues calculated under open and periodic boundary conditions, named as bulk-bulk correspondence ( ℬ ​ ℬ ​ 𝒞 \mathcal{BBC} ), can be destroyed in systems with non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE). In spite of the great success of the generalized Brillouin zone (GBZ) theory in clean non-Hermitian systems, the applicability of GBZ theory is questionable when the translational symmetry is broken.

arxiv-2211-05563.title: A generic framework for genuine multipartite entanglement detection
arxiv-2211-05563.creator: Xin-Yu Xu, Qing Zhou, Shuai Zhao, Shu-Ming Hu, Li Li, Nai-Le Liu, Kai Chen
arxiv-2211-05563.description: Abstract Design of detection strategies for multipartite entanglement stands as a central importance on our understanding of fundamental quantum mechanics and has had substantial impact on quantum information applications. However, accurate and robust detection approaches are severely hindered, particularly when the number of nodes grows rapidly like in a quantum network.

arxiv-2211-08605.title: A Dichotomy Theorem for Linear Time Homomorphism Orbit Counting in Bounded Degeneracy Graphs
arxiv-2211-08605.creator: Daniel Paul-Pena, C. Seshadhri
arxiv-2211-08605.description: Abstract Counting the number of homomorphisms of a pattern graph H H in a large input graph G G is a fundamental problem in computer science. In many applications in databases, bioinformatics, and network science, we need more than just the total count.

arxiv-2211-11034.title: The real-time growth rate of stochastic epidemics on random intersection graphs
arxiv-2211-11034.creator: Carolina Fransson
arxiv-2211-11034.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carolina Fransson. This paper is concerned with the growth rate of SIR (Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered) epidemics with general infectious period distribution on random intersection graphs. This type of graph is characterized by the presence of cliques (fully connected subgraphs).

arxiv-2403-06907.title: Towards Incident Response Orchestration and Automation for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure
arxiv-2403-06907.creator: Alexios Lekidis 1 , Vasileios Mavroeidis 2 and Konstantinos Fysarakis 3
arxiv-2403-06907.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexios Lekidis 1 , Vasileios Mavroeidis 2 and Konstantinos Fysarakis 3. The threat landscape of industrial infrastructures has expanded exponentially over the last few years. Such infrastructures include services such as the smart meter data exchange that should have real-time availability. Smart meters constitute the main component of the Advanced Metering Infrastructure, and their measurements are also used as historical data for forecasting the energy demand to avoid load peaks that could lead to blackouts within specific areas.

arxiv-2403-19363.title: Dynamic Correlation of Market Connectivity, Risk Spillover and Abnormal Volatility in Stock Price Journal: Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications
arxiv-2403-19363.creator: Muzi Chen, Nan Li, Lifen Zheng, Difang Huang, Boyao Wu
arxiv-2403-19363.description: Abstract The connectivity of stock markets reflects the information efficiency of capital markets and contributes to interior risk contagion and spillover effects. We compare Shanghai Stock Exchange A-shares (SSE A-shares) during tranquil periods, with high leverage periods associated with the 2015 subprime mortgage crisis.

arxiv-2407-13286.title: Lagrangian Skeleta and Koszul Duality on Bionic Symplectic Varieties
arxiv-2407-13286.creator: Gwyn Bellamy, Christopher Dodd, Kevin McGerty, Thomas Nevins
arxiv-2407-13286.description: Abstract . We consider the category of modules over sheaves of Deformation-Quantization (DQ) algebras on bionic symplectic varieties. These spaces are equipped with both an elliptic 𝔾 m {\mathbb{G}}_{m} -action and a Hamiltonian 𝔾 m {\mathbb{G}}_{m} -action, with finitely many fixed points.

arxiv-2411-08373.title: DG-SLAM: Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Hybrid Pose Optimization
arxiv-2411-08373.creator: Yueming Xu, Haochen Jiang, Zhongyang Xiao, Jianfeng Feng, Li Zhang
arxiv-2411-08373.description: Abstract Achieving robust and precise pose estimation in dynamic scenes is a significant research challenge in Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Recent advancements integrating Gaussian Splatting into SLAM systems have proven effective in creating high-quality renderings using explicit 3D Gaussian models, significantly improving environmental reconstruction fidelity.

arxiv-2508-12801.title: Maximum Score Routing For Mixture-of-Experts
arxiv-2508-12801.creator: Bowen Dong 1 , Yilong Fan 2 , Yutao Sun 1 , Zhenyu Li 1 , Tengyu Pan 1 , Xun Zhou 3 † \dagger , Jianyong Wang 1 † \dagger 1 Tsinghua University, 2 Tianjin University, 3 Seed-Foundation-Model Team, ByteDance dbw22@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2508-12801.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bowen Dong 1 , Yilong Fan 2 , Yutao Sun 1 , Zhenyu Li 1 , Tengyu Pan 1 , Xun Zhou 3 † \dagger , Jianyong Wang 1 † \dagger 1 Tsinghua University, 2 Tianjin University, 3 Seed-Foundation-Model Team, ByteDance dbw22@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn. Routing networks in sparsely activated mixture-of-experts (MoE) dynamically allocate input tokens to top-k experts through differentiable sparse transformations, enabling scalable model capacity while preserving computational efficiency. Traditional MoE networks impose an expert capacity constraint to ensure GPU-friendly computation.

arxiv-2511-22978.title: ShoppingComp: Are LLMs Really Ready for Your Shopping Cart?
arxiv-2511-22978.creator: Huaixiao Tou, Ying Zeng, Cong Ma, Muzhi Li, Minghao Li, Weijie Yuan, He Zhang, Kai Jia
arxiv-2511-22978.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huaixiao Tou, Ying Zeng, Cong Ma, Muzhi Li, Minghao Li, Weijie Yuan, He Zhang, Kai Jia. We present ShoppingComp, a challenging real-world benchmark for rigorously evaluating LLM-powered shopping agents on three core capabilities: precise product retrieval, expert-level report generation, and safety critical decision making. Unlike prior e-commerce benchmarks, ShoppingComp introduces highly complex tasks under the principle of guaranteeing real products and ensuring easy verifiability, adding a novel evaluation dimension for identifying product safety hazards alongside recommendation accuracy and report quality.

arxiv-2512-10161.title: Hadronic contributions to a μ a_{\mu} within Resonance Chiral Theory
arxiv-2512-10161.creator: Emilio J. Estrada, Alejandro Miranda, Pablo Roig
arxiv-2512-10161.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Emilio J. Estrada, Alejandro Miranda, Pablo Roig. We review the recent progress achieved, using Resonance Chiral Theory, in the hadronic contributions to the muon anomalous magnetic moment. These include the hadronic vacuum polarization, either using e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} or τ \tau decays into hadron final states as input; and the hadronic light-by-light part, where in addition to previous results on the lightest pseudoscalar and tensor-poles contributions, we first present the evaluation of the pseudoscalar box using this formalism.

europmc-pmc8002175.creator: Stoler N, Nekrutenko A.
europmc-pmc8002175.description: Sequencing technology has achieved great advances in the past decade. Studies have previously shown the quality of specific instruments in controlled conditions. pmc-10653117.title: Toward an Accurate Black-Box Tool for the Kinetics of Gas-Phase Reactions Involving Barrier-less Elementary Steps
pmc-10653117.creator: Luigi Crisci, Silvia Di Grande, Carlo Cavallotti, Vincenzo Barone
pmc-10653117.description: An enhanced computational protocol has been devised for the accurate characterization of gas-phase barrier-less reactions in the framework of the reaction-path (RP) and variable reaction coordinate variational transition-state theory. In particular, the synergistic combination of density functional theory and Monte Carlo sampling to optimize reactive fluxes led to a reliable yet effective computational workflow.

pmc-11366238.title: TaqMan qPCR and IgM Detection in Samples of Patients with Tick-Borne Encephalitis Virus Infection in Northeast China
pmc-11366238.creator: Menghan Yu, Xiaoshu Fu, Yanli Zhu, Miao Li, Min Wu, Entong Zhou, Hanwen Dong, Likun Wang, Ruoxi Wang, Fang Liu, Chunlai Jiang, Xiangwei Kong, Weiheng Su
pmc-11366238.description: PurposeTick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV) infections result in severe central nervous system diseases in humans across Asia and Europe. In China, cases of tick-borne encephalitis are primarily caused by the Far East subtype of TBEV, which exhibits a distinct disease course compared to other extensively studied subtypes.

pmc-11605357.title: Research status and future focus on Codonopsis pilosula: A bibliometric analysis of past and present studies
pmc-11605357.creator: Doudou Yang, Qingqing Zhang, Zhuodi Wu, Yuan Chen, Ziping Cai, Liang Zhao, Dandan Zhang, Yinku Liang
pmc-11605357.description: BackgroundCodonopsis pilosula is a traditional herb widely used in Asian countries. As regulatory institutions increasingly acknowledge its medicinal and food-related characteristics, the attention from scholars is expected to increase rapidly. However, an overview and reports on research focus on this promising herb are currently lacking.

pmc-12285512.title: A Road Less Traveled: Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography in a Patient with Long-standing Achalasia and Sigmoid Esophagus
pmc-12285512.creator: Nadia O. Trabelsi, Katherine Marchut, Sally Romina Urena Campos, Davide Maggio, George Rakovich
pmc-12285512.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography in a patient with achalasia and sigmoid esophagus poses a unique technical challenge, as one must safely guide the side viewing duodenoscope across a severely distorted distal esophagus and non-relaxing lower esophageal sphincter. In such patients, the use of an overtube is a simple solution that allows the safe passage of a duodenoscope and the removal of common bile duct stones. INTRODUCTION

Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) in patients with altered esophageal anatomy or stenosis can be challenging.

pmc-13610263.title: Synaptic Adaptations in the Amygdala During Alprazolam Withdrawal: Insights from a Female Rat Model of Benzodiazepine Withdrawal
